doc.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Popular tunes played by the family band
summary: Young recalls the family band played popular tunes such as St. Louis Blues, Stormy Weather and I'm Confessin'.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: What kind of music were you playing in the, I know you said jazz, but do you remember any of the tunes or any of the songs you played in the family band?

Pop tunes? Young:…popular tunes. Like the regular tunes, I could have been St. Louis Blues, it could have been, oh I can‘t think of the tunes. Regular tunes like Stormy Weather and back in them days those tunes were…

And it was a lot of popular, Confessin’…I’m Confessin’ [sings melody]. Confessing…I’m Confessin’. Well, a lot of things like that, we used to play them, my dad used to sing and play, he played good saxophone. And he was good…
